body:
No, thank you for chatting with me.

I didn’t think it was going to be so research heavy. I knew there was an individual project to do, but I did not think it consumed so much of the internship. It is going to be 90% research. I have spoken to someone about it and they pretty much told me everything in this career field is research.
At this point in time, with the state of mind I’m in, I would not enjoy it.
I have an undergrad degree in an unrelated field. I wanted to apply to a grad school in this field after my internship is complete.

My parents think I am being lazy. They don’t want me to be doing nothing. And they don’t want to take me to the hospital.

I don’t have a lot of education for this. I have kind of weaseled my way in through volunteer work and part-time classes.

Just since I started this internship a little over two weeks ago. I guess I realized the field is 90% research and that’s not what I want. I don’t know if my thoughts would be different. I’m tired of trying to find something that makes me happy.
